## What was built

`/home/agent/todo-app/` — a dependency-free Node app (standard library only):

```
server.js            HTTP server: static files + JSON API
package.json         no dependencies; `npm start` runs the server
public/index.html    single page
public/style.css     dark theme, responsive
public/app.js        vanilla-JS frontend, no build step
data/todos.json      created on first write
README.md
```

Features: add, inline-rename (click the text), toggle done, delete, All/Active/Done filters, clear-completed, live counts, and error toasts. State persists to `data/todos.json` through serialized atomic temp-file writes, so concurrent requests can't corrupt it.

## Status

- Running: `node server.js`, PID 430, listening on `0.0.0.0:3000` (left running).
- Verified: `/health`, full create → list → patch → delete cycle, all three static assets (200), persistence on disk, plus validation paths (400 on empty title / non-boolean `done`), 404 for unknown ids, 405 on bad methods, and path-traversal rejection.

## Preview

Published: **https://sandbox-51704a008dc2-3000.tangle.sh** — router status `ready`, edge probe returns `200`.

Two things worth flagging honestly:

1. **I could not fetch that URL from inside this sandbox.** The sandbox's egress proxy (`HTTPS_PROXY=[redacted]:1080`) returns `403 Forbidden` on `CONNECT` to the preview hostname. That's an egress-policy restriction, not an app failure — you should load the URL from your own browser to confirm rendering.
2. The edge probe initially reported `404`. It was hitting `/.well-known/tangle-preview-readiness`, which didn't exist, so I added that route returning `{ready:true}`; the probe now reports `200`. If your runtime uses a different readiness path, that's the file to adjust (`server.js`).

input.content:
# To-Do App

A small to-do list web app written in plain Node.js with **zero dependencies** — only
the Node standard library (`http`, `fs`, `path`, `crypto`). No `npm install` required.

## Run

```bash
node server.js          # listens on http://0.0.0.0:3000
PORT=4000 node server.js  # custom port
ACCESS_LOG=1 node server.js  # log every request
```

## Features

- Add, rename (inline edit), complete, and delete tasks
- Filter by All / Active / Done, and clear completed in one click
- Optimistic UI with error toasts; live "N active · M completed" summary
- Persists to `data/todos.json` via atomic temp-file writes (writes are serialized)
- Single-page frontend in vanilla JS — no build step, no framework

## Layout

```
todo-app/
├── server.js            # HTTP server: static files + JSON API
├── package.json         # no dependencies; `npm start` runs the server
├── public/
│   ├── index.html
│   ├── style.css
│   └── app.js
└── data/todos.json      # created on first write
```

## API

| Method | Path | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ----------- |
| `GET` | `/api/todos` | List all tasks |
| `POST` | `/api/todos` | Create a task — body `{ "title": "..." }` |
| `GET` | `/api/todos/:id` | Fetch one task |
| `PATCH`/`PUT` | `/api/todos/:id` | Update `title` and/or `done` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/todos/:id` | Delete one task |
| `DELETE` | `/api/todos` | Delete all tasks |
| `GET` | `/health` | Health/status check |

Titles are trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, and capped at 200 characters. `done` must be a
boolean. Paths are resolved against `public/` and rejected if they escape it. Bodies are
limited to 64 KB.

## Environment

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
| -------- | ------- | ------- |
| `PORT` | `3000` | Listen port |
| `HOST` | `0.0.0.0` | Bind address |
| `DATA_FILE` | `./data/todos.json` | Storage location |
| `ACCESS_LOG` | unset | Set to `1` to log requests |

input.content:
# To-Do App

A small to-do list web app written in plain Node.js with **zero dependencies** — only
the Node standard library (`http`, `fs`, `path`, `crypto`). No `npm install` required.

## Run

```bash
node server.js          # listens on http://0.0.0.0:3000
PORT=4000 node server.js  # custom port
ACCESS_LOG=1 node server.js  # log every request
```

## Features

- Add, rename (inline edit), complete, and delete tasks
- Filter by All / Active / Done, and clear completed in one click
- Optimistic UI with error toasts; live "N active · M completed" summary
- Persists to `data/todos.json` via atomic temp-file writes (writes are serialized)
- Single-page frontend in vanilla JS — no build step, no framework

## Layout

```
todo-app/
├── server.js            # HTTP server: static files + JSON API
├── package.json         # no dependencies; `npm start` runs the server
├── public/
│   ├── index.html
│   ├── style.css
│   └── app.js
└── data/todos.json      # created on first write
```

## API

| Method | Path | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ----------- |
| `GET` | `/api/todos` | List all tasks |
| `POST` | `/api/todos` | Create a task — body `{ "title": "..." }` |
| `GET` | `/api/todos/:id` | Fetch one task |
| `PATCH`/`PUT` | `/api/todos/:id` | Update `title` and/or `done` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/todos/:id` | Delete one task |
| `DELETE` | `/api/todos` | Delete all tasks |
| `GET` | `/health` | Health/status check |
